稻.def: rice plant; rice growing in the field

origin.says: 禾 (grain plant) for the meaning plus 舀 (scoop) as the sound: rice growing in the field.

稻.name: rice plant

origin.says: A drawing of a pot with a lid on top and a round belly. Simplified from 壺, whose lower part is shortened; the modern parts are only shapes.
亻 (person) for the meaning plus 需 (need) as the sound: the learned men of ritual, later the Confucian scholars.

恕.def: to excuse, to forgive, to show mercy

origin.says: 心 (heart) for the meaning plus 如 (as, like) as the sound: a heart that treats others like oneself, so 'to forgive'.

恕.name: pardon

origin.says: From 綽: 糸 (silk) for the meaning plus 卓 (tall) as the sound: loose, ample, graceful like flowing silk. 糸 became 纟.
忄 (heart) for the meaning plus 康 (health) as the sound: an ardent, generous heart. Originally written 忼.
A picture of a hand grabbing from above, read as a claw or talon. On top of other characters it is written 爫.

肖.def: to resemble, to look like; to be like

origin.says: 小 (small) plus 月 (moon): one reading has the moon growing small, 'fade' (now 消); another takes 小 as the sound and the old dictionary read 月 as flesh. Now 'resemble'.

肖.name: resemble
肖.in: 消销削稍悄宵屑哨硝峭捎梢俏霄

origin.says: Simplified from 癢: 疒 (sickness) for the meaning plus 養 (rear) as the sound: to itch. The sound part was cut to 羊 (sheep).
纟 (thread) for the meaning plus 少 (few; short for 沙 sand) as the sound: fine gauze or yarn. Simplified from 紗, with 糸 written 纟.
日 (sun) for the meaning plus 未 (not yet) as the sound: the sun not yet out, dim, dark; hence obscure, ignorant.

磋.def: to polish, to buff; to examine, to deliberate

啸.def: to roar, to howl; to scream; to whistle

origin.says: 口 (mouth) for the meaning plus 肃 as the sound: to whistle, howl, roar. Simplified from 嘯 (肅 → 肃).

啸.name: howl

畔.def: river bank; a boundary path that divides fields

ety.hint: A farm 田 divided in half 半; 半 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 田 (field) for the meaning plus 半 (half) as the sound: the path that divides fields, then the bank of a river or lake.

畔.name: bank

origin.says: 革 (leather) for the meaning plus 便 (convenient) as the sound: a leather whip.

ety.hint: The space between 夹 two mountains 山; 夹 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 山 (mountain) for the meaning plus 夹 (to squeeze between) as the sound: a narrow pass squeezed between mountains, a gorge. Simplified from 峽 by writing 夾 (squeeze) as 夹.

藉.def: by means of; excuse, pretext; to rely on

ety.hint: A plow 耤 is the means used to grow crops 艹

origin.says: 艹 (plant, straw) for the meaning plus 耤 (tilling the field) as the sound: a straw mat to rest on, hence to rely on, by means of.

藉.name: straw mat

origin.says: Simplified from 憊: 備 (prepared) as the sound plus 心 (heart) for the meaning: worn out. 備 was replaced by its simplified form 备, giving 备 over 心.

撕.def: to rip, to tear; to buy cloth

origin.says: 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 斯 (to split; this) as the sound and meaning: to tear, to rip apart.

撕.name: tear

掏.def: to take out; to pull out; to clean out

origin.says: 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 匋 (pottery-making) as the sound: to dig out, to pull something out with the hand.

掏.name: dig out

origin.says: 口 (mouth) for the meaning plus 付 (hand over) as the sound: handing over orders by mouth, 'to instruct'.

钞.def: bank note, paper money; to counterfeit

origin.says: Simplified from 鈔: 钅 (metal) for the meaning plus 少 (few) as the sound; first 'to snatch', later paper money. Only the metal part was simplified (釒 to 钅).

钞.name: bank note

origin.says: 木 (wood) for the meaning plus 庄 (village) as the sound: a wooden stake or post. It replaces traditional 樁, written with a different sound part.
origin.src: Dong Chinese; own knowledge for 樁

ety.hint: A person leaning forward to ask for help

origin.says: The origin is unclear; one reading sees a person bent forward holding out a hand, begging. It means beggar, to beg.

呐.def: to raise one's voice; to yell, to shout; to stammer

origin.says: 口 (mouth) for the meaning plus 内 as the sound: to speak haltingly, and to shout.

呐.name: stammer

诽.def: to condemn, to slander, to vilify

origin.says: 讠 (speech) for the meaning plus 非 (wrong) as sound and meaning: to speak against someone, to slander. Simplified from 誹.

诽.name: slander

ety.hint: Setting fire 火 to a forest 林

origin.says: 林 (trees) over 火 (fire): setting a forest on fire, to burn.
月 (here flesh, body part) for the meaning plus 宛 (winding) as the sound: the wrist, the bending part of the arm.
讠 (speech) for the meaning plus 旁 (beside) as the sound: to speak ill of others, slander. Simplified from 謗 (言 → 讠).

敷.def: to apply, to paint, to spread

origin.says: 尃 (to spread out) as the sound and meaning plus 攵 (hand in action): to spread on, apply. The 寸 (hand) at the bottom left of 尃 was long ago replaced by 方.

敷.name: spread on

诬.def: to slander, to defame; a false accusation

ety.hint: To start 讠 a witch-hunt 巫; 巫 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 言 (speech) for the meaning plus 巫 (shaman) as the sound: false words against someone, slander. Simplified from 誣.

诬.name: false charge

飘.def: to drift, to float, to flutter

origin.says: Simplified from 飄: 票 (ticket) as the sound plus 風 (wind) for the meaning, with 風 written 风: to be blown about, to flutter, to float in the air.

飘.name: flutter

origin.says: 艹 (plant) for the meaning plus 匊 (handful) as the sound: the chrysanthemum.
氵 (water) for the meaning plus 军 (army) as the sound: water churned and mixed, muddy. Simplified from 渾 (軍 to 军).
Simplified from 鴨: 鸟 (bird) for the meaning plus 甲 (shell armor) as the sound, probably imitating the duck's call. 鳥 became its cursive shape 鸟.

ety.hint: Using a spoon 勹 to measure out two equal parts 冫

origin.says: 勹 (an old drawing of a worm) as the sound plus two marks, two equal weights now written 冫: an even unit of weight, hence even and uniform.
Simplified from 壘: 畾 (piled fields) as the sound plus 土 (earth) for the meaning: piled earth, a rampart. The three 田 (field) were replaced by three 厶.
口 (mouth) for the meaning plus 剌 (to slash) as the sound: a sound word, used for horns blown with the mouth and in foreign names.

蜀.def: the name of an ancient state

origin.says: A drawing of a caterpillar or silkworm with a big eye (now 罒) on a curled body (勹 wrap); 虫 (insect) was added inside. Used as the name of the ancient state in Sichuan.

蜀.name: silkworm land

origin.says: 石 (stone) for the meaning plus 兹 as the sound: the lodestone, a stone that draws iron, hence magnetic; also porcelain.
巾 (cloth) for the meaning plus 凡 (ordinary) as the sound: cloth that catches the wind, 'sail'.
扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 那 (that) as the sound: to move something by hand, to shift.
氵 (water) for the meaning plus 必 (must) as the sound: liquid seeping out, to secrete.
木 (tree) for the meaning plus 西 (west, at first a nest) as the sound: birds perching in a tree. It is the old variant that replaced 棲 (perch, with 妻 wife as the sound).
女 (woman) for the meaning plus 叟 (old man) as the sound: an older brother's wife.
讠 (speech) for the meaning plus 覃 (deep) as the sound: deep talk; now a surname. Simplified from 譚 with 言 in its short form.

ety.hint: A small 小 bird 隹

origin.says: 小 (small) above 隹 (short-tailed bird): a small bird, the sparrow. The top looks like 少 (few) because the first stroke of 隹 was stretched up into it.

ety.hint: An ox 牛 with a tail 尾

origin.says: 尾 (tail) as the sound plus 牛 (ox) for the meaning: an ox-like animal, the rhinoceros; also sharp. The 毛 (hair) part of 尾 has changed into a water-like shape.
日 (sun, day) for the meaning plus 叚 (to borrow) as the sound: free days, leisure, spare time.
月 (flesh) for the meaning plus 各 (each) as the sound: the arm, the armpit.
金 (metal) for the meaning plus 呂 (twin blocks) as the sound; once 'ingot', reused in modern times for aluminium because 呂 sounds like its first syllable. Simplified as 钅 and 吕.

揍.def: to hit, to beat; to smash, to break

origin.says: 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 奏 (to play) as the sound: to hit, to beat up.

揍.name: thrash

铸.def: to melt, to cast; to mint, to coin

origin.says: 钅 (metal) for the meaning plus 寿 (long life) as the sound: to cast metal. Simplified from 鑄; early forms showed crucibles, fire and hands.

铸.name: cast metal

origin.says: 月 (flesh) for the meaning plus 尃 (spread out) as the sound: the shoulder and upper arm.

ety.hint: A jade statue 王 with four holes made in it 口

origin.says: Probably a variant related to 咢 (startled cries) and 喪 (mourning, a tree with wailing mouths): four 口 (mouth) around a 王-like (king) trunk. Hence ill-omened.

摊.def: to spread out, to open, to allot; a merchant's stand

origin.says: 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 难 (difficult) as the sound: to spread out by hand, and so a stall where goods are spread out. Simplified from 攤 by the same change as 難 → 难.

摊.name: street stall

拐.def: to kidnap, to abduct; to turn; crutch

ety.hint: To take another 另 by force 扌

origin.says: 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 冎 (bone) as the sound; the sound part changed shape into 另 (another). Meanings: a crutch, to turn a corner, to lure away.

拐.name: crutch

origin.says: 艹 (plant) for the meaning plus 庶 (multitude) as the sound: sugar cane.

洽.def: to mix, to blend, to harmonize

ety.hint: To combine 合 two solutions 氵

origin.says: 氵 (water) for the meaning plus 合 (join) as the sound, which also fits: waters mixing together, to blend, get along, consult.

洽.name: blend

origin.says: 亻 (person) for the meaning plus 畺 (field boundaries) as the sound: a body lying stiff and motionless.

鸣.def: a bird call or animal cry; to make a sound

ety.hint: The sound 口 a bird 鸟 makes

origin.says: 口 (mouth) with 鳥 (bird): a bird's cry, to sound. Simplified from 鳴, with 鸟 for 鳥.

鸣.name: birdcall

ety.hint: A mouth 口 exhaling 又

origin.says: Simplified from 嘆: 口 (mouth) for the meaning plus 歎 (to sigh) as the sound. The right side was replaced by the simple stand-in 又.

ety.hint: One 一 voice 口 surrounded by conflict 戈

origin.says: 戌 (axe weapon) plus 口 (mouth, maybe only a mark): one reading sees slaughter, 'to finish', hence 'all'. The simplified script also uses it for 鹹 (salty: 鹵 salt + 咸 as the sound).
A reduced form of 鬻: 米 (rice) cooking in a 鬲 (cauldron) with steam rising on both sides. The cauldron was dropped and the steam lines came to look like two 弓 (bow).

ety.hint: To shake 执 hands 手; 执 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 手 (hand) for the meaning plus 执 (hold) as the sound: to grasp firmly, hence sincere, earnest. Simplified from 摯 (執 → 执).
禾 (grain plant) for the meaning plus 高 (tall) as the sound: first grain stalks or straw, then a rough draft.
艹 (plant) for the meaning plus 波 (wave) as the sound: spinach.
艹 (grass) for the meaning plus 牙 (tooth) as the sound, and perhaps the sense: a shoot poking out like a tooth, a bud or sprout.

匈.def: breast, chest, thorax; to clamor; Hungary

origin.says: 勹 (wrap) for the meaning plus 凶 (ominous) as the sound: the wrapped-around chest, the original form of 胸 (chest); now used mainly in names (the Xiongnu, Hungary).

匈.name: rib cage

拽.def: to drag, to tow; to throw; to twist

ety.hint: To pull 曳 by hand 扌; 曳 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 曳 (drag) as the sound: to pull, to drag.

拽.name: yank

origin.says: A modern coinage for hydrogen: 气 (gas) for the meaning plus the right side of 轻 (light) for sound and meaning, the gas lighter than air. Simplified from 氫. (The gloss 'ammonia' in the packet is wrong.)
艹 (plant) for the meaning plus 署 (bureau) as the sound: a tuber such as the yam or potato.
